title: Marketing / Cast / Background choices
slide_intent: Match background freedom to the subject because different color structures create different interactions with the same palette.
strategic_value: The cast’s varied hues can give Duolingo more background options than the predominantly green mascot.
demonstration: Four cropped characters appear on white, green, blue and yellow squares beside a comparison with Duo.
practical_value: Evaluate each character’s colors before selecting a core or secondary background.

content_islands.name: Background examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange the four character portraits in a two-by-two grid of white, green, blue and yellow fields.

content_islands.name: Scope of flexibility
content_islands.spec: Explain the broader core and secondary background range at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source attributes reduced color vibration to the characters’ broader range of hues.
reference_purposes.Application: Four portraits demonstrate varied background choices.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The cast can use a broader range of core and secondary colors than Duo.

ingredient.name: Cast background colors
ingredient.role: Support varied characters without harsh color interaction.
ingredient.application: Select from the broader core and secondary color range while checking the character against its background.
ingredient.scope: Historical cast guidance; the four examples are not stated as an exhaustive palette.
